item.title: Dilemma Lite <= 1.1.1 - Unauthenticated Stored XSS via Dilemma Submission
item.description: The Dilemma Lite WordPress plugin through 1.1.1 does not sanitise or escape the choices of dilemmas submitted by visitors before outputting them in the admin dashboard and on the front end, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

item.title: WOW-CMS BlizzCMS Home Home.php setconfig improper authorization
item.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in WOW-CMS BlizzCMS up to 1.2.1. Affected is the function Home::setconfig of the file application/modules/home/controllers/Home.php of the component Home Module. The manipulation leads to improper authorization. item.title: soapbar: verify envelope bsp accepts an unauthenticated embedded certificate (signature forgery / authentication bypass)
item.description: Impact verify envelope bsp() derived its trust anchor from the message it was verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken , validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify envelope bsp()…

item.title: TwigView FileLoader may allow arbitrary file reads through user-controlled template paths
item.description: Impact If FileLoader::findTemplate() is supplied un-validated user controlled data, arbitrary files can be read. Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue. Workarounds Don't supply user controlled data to include and extends tags.
